text: Nail-biting is a common habit that may be linked to stress or may simply be a habit; on its own it does not mean anxiety. Do not scold or mock him, notice when it happens, offer a safe way to keep his hands busy, and see a doctor if it causes bleeding or pain.

review_defects.why: «توتر» means 'tension/stress' rather than 'anxiety' (which would be «قلق»); a minor nuance shift.
